sources.label: Material You, ad and tracker removal, and premium unlocks for Android apps.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Stops Detik Analytics from recording screens and events, keeps the Android ID out of article pages, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions.
Removes the ad banners, native ads, full-screen ads and video ads, and the ads on detik.com pages opened in the app.
Shows every page of a multi-page article in one continuous article, without the page numbers.
Stops the videos and live streams embedded in articles from playing on their own. They play when tapped.
